name: Cinematheque
description: Cinematheque adds a tab to the Jellyfin web client for film lovers: directors and actors with their filmography in your library, national cinemas (Hong Kong, Japan, Italy...) with a decade breakdown, and curated film movements such as the French New Wave or Italian Neorealism. Requires the File Transformation plugin for the tab.
overview: Browse your films by director, actor, country and film movement

versions.changelog: First release: directors, actors, countries and movements.
